name: former-names-dropped
breaks: a v9 node lists a component of an app registered before v9 under its 8.x name too, among the components it holds
red: installs the app on the 8.20 node and does not start the component the v9 primary holds
does not start it through a restart of the 8.20 node's FluxOS

name: folder-id-from-the-identity
breaks: an app registered before v9 shares its data under the folder id its registration fixed, its 8.x name, which an 8.x node shares it under too
red: installs the app on the 8.20 node and does not start the component the v9 primary holds
does not start it through a restart of the 8.20 node's FluxOS
shares the data under the 8.x folder id on a fresh v9 node, syncs the primary's data, and shares the folder with both peers
